source: stadtplan_1920_10k_PAN.jpg (Plan der Stadt Danzig 1920, Städt. Vermessungsamt, 1:10000, 300 dpi scan via mapywig/Mapster)
output: map1920_warped.png, 2400x2400 px, 0.25 m/px, north up, covers ENU E,N in [-300,300] m around origin 54.3825003N 18.6262664E
pixel_to_enu: E = a*px + b*py + c ; N = d*px + e*py + f (px,py = source-scan pixel, y down)

control_points.what: Baerenweg bend x Neptunweg (Mickiewicza x Sochaczewska)
railway centreline near Hst. Reichskolonie (lateral only)
Neptunweg axis 55 m north of Baerenweg (lateral only)

note: The 1920 plan is a compiled 1:10000 city plan; the Reichskolonie is drawn schematically (row blocks, streets slightly rotated, railway bend exaggerated). Positional accuracy after affine fit ~5-8 m in the block core, worse (10-20 m) beyond 250 m. Use map1933_warped.png for footprint-level geometry.
